papers.summary: DISCO以冻结e-process与粗分箱选择接口控制行为发现集合的FDR，允许最终使用实际假设数；本地仅有未boosted二分箱统计核心。 CPU-only unboosted binary-bin Algorithm2, exact finite-null path enumeration and Theorems1/2; no models, datasets, LLM discovery/judging, three-bin boosting or capability evidence.
